research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SRTX appears to be researching ultra high molecular weight polyethylene membranes and clothing articles having ultra high molecular weight polyethylene, focusing on rip resistant, tear resistant and burst resistant textiles. Work on open knit apparel comprising ultra high molecular weight polyethylene and ultra high molecular weight polyethylene material reduction for weft knit structures targets durable, stretchable, comfortable garments and single layer waterproof or protective articles. These efforts span membranes, base knits, and open knit apparel.
